title: Research bounded experimental authorization
description:
Research current Part 5 experimental-authorization procedures as an optional, separately selectable R&D path. Identify applicant, emission, power, location, duration, control and reporting information needed for the contemplated work. Keep this separate from production equipment authorization and amateur operation.

HPC8 execution policy: Code, test, or schema changes require three independent correctness, security, and robustness reviews; file and fix all findings and re-review. Use independent oracles, never weakened legacy tests or self-generated expected results. Preserve upstream Yggdrasil addressing, radio-owned identity, best-effort custody, baseline SCHC, and the human-only OSCORE/EDHOC security edit bar. External actions, hardware/RF operations, and port access require scoped explicit permission and applicable bench safety checks. Research may conclude no-go; an authorization gate requires affirmative, recorded approval for its actual scope. Dependency closure and decomposition are not permission. No speculative activation, including deferred portability or experimental modes.
design: Read-only procedural research. Do not open an application, register an applicant, contact an agency, pay a fee or file anything. Any selected filing is deferred authority.13 and requires a specific human decision and submission permission.
acceptance_criteria: Primary sources distinguish application preparation, submission, acknowledgement, authorization and permitted operation. Produce an applicability checklist with unresolved facts, not a promised approval, cost, lead time or operating basis. Existing Part 15 deployment decisions remain intact.
